_comment: Mock Mattermost Push Proxy config (SIMULACRUM). Keys mirror mattermost-push-proxy's real mattermost-push-proxy.json so migration to a real proxy is a config swap. For the mock, ServerID is just an opaque id (use the Mattermost DiagnosticId to stay drop-in); Secret is accepted but not yet enforced by the mock. ApplePushSettings.Topic should be the app's APNs bundle id. Devices is a dev-only registry the mock grows at runtime. DO NOT ship real secrets here.
